description: This source file is a JUnit test suite for testing various query operations in the Entity engine of the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends a base test case class and contains multiple test methods to verify functionalities like query count, filtering, ordering, selecting specific fields, dealing with distinct values, using iterators, and handling cursor types. It exercises the EntityQuery utility and Entity engine's delegation to ensure correct behavior for different query parameters and options.

classes.name: EntityQueryTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite class extending EntityTestCase for comprehensive testing of entity query functionalities in OFBiz.

methods.name: testQueryCount
methods.description: Tests the queryCount() method of EntityQuery to verify it returns the correct total number of records for a given entity.

methods.name: testWhere
methods.description: Tests the where() method of EntityQuery for filtering records with specific conditions.

methods.name: testQueryList
methods.description: Tests the queryList() method to retrieve all records and validate their correctness.

methods.name: testQueryFirst
methods.description: Tests the queryFirst() method to fetch the first matching record.

methods.name: testQueryOne
methods.description: Tests the queryOne() method to retrieve a single record based on conditions.

methods.name: testQueryOneWithContext
methods.description: Tests queryOne() with context and parameters to resolve a record.

methods.name: testSelect
methods.description: Tests select() to fetch only specific fields from records.

methods.name: testDistinctAndSelect
methods.description: Tests distinct() combined with select() to get unique field values.

methods.name: testOrderBy
methods.description: Tests orderBy() to ensure records are sorted correctly.

methods.name: testFilterByDate
methods.description: Tests filterByDate() to retrieve only active records based on date fields.

methods.name: testMaxRows
methods.description: Tests maxRows() setting for limiting number of fetched records.

methods.name: testFetchSize
methods.description: Tests fetchSize() setting for controlling fetch batch size.

methods.name: testQueryIterator
methods.description: Tests the queryIterator() method to iterate over records.

methods.name: testCursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Tests cursorForwardOnly() to verify forward-only cursor behavior.

methods.name: testCursorScrollSensitive
methods.description: Tests cursorScrollSensitive() for a scrollable, sensitive cursor.

methods.name: testCache
methods.description: Tests cache() to verify caching behavior during queries.

methods.name: testCursorScrollInSensitive
methods.description: Tests cursorScrollInsensitive() for a scrollable, insensitive cursor.
